cond_0001.intro: The Senior Plant Engineer is responsible for the operation and optimization of the equipment, systems and utilities of a cGMP Cell Therapy Manufacturing Facility. Collaborate with Maintenance and Metrology groups to develop programs for equipment maintenance and calibrations. Coordinate with the Facilities, Engineering, Operations and Quality teams to ensure maximum uptime and efficiency of all systems and equipment.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Support the design, installation, start-up, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of equipment, systems and utilities associated with cGMP Manufacturing, Laboratories and Warehouse. Demonstrate a strong understanding of HVAC, controls, mechanical, electrical and utility systems, and be able to troubleshoot as necessary. Understanding of thermodynamics, psychrometric properties and HVAC/mechanical design is highly desirable. Monitor and respond to alarms generated from the BMS/QEMS, including off-hours and weekends. Responsible for launching and/or supporting technical investigations, deviations, CAPAs, etc. Related to GMP facilities, utilities, and equipment. Develop and/or enhance departmental standard operating procedures. Ensure through continuous improvement and routine monitoring that equipment works to design and manufacturer's specifications. Participate in the planning, design, budgeting, scheduling and execution of assigned projects. Establishes programs and solutions for increasing uptime and for equipment problems that affect the manufacturing process. Independently applies advanced engineering techniques and analysis and provide technical guidance to less experienced design and engineering personnel. Conduct routine inspections of premises and equipment. Oversee work performed by maintenance and/or external contractors to ensure conformance to design and industry standards. Other duties as required.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering field.
5 Years of related BioPharma/Life Sciences experience.
Demonstrable experience with cGMP capital, maintenance, and operating projects.
Has comprehensive understanding of principles, theories, concepts, and industry practices and standards and their application.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Preferred Requirements
Prior experience with Facilities operations in a cell therapy manufacturing facility, or experience with cell therapy manufacturing facility MEP design.
Extensive knowledge and experience designing/operating to ASHRAE, ISO, ISPE, SMACNA, etc.
Experience using Computerized Maintenance Management Software (Blue Mountain).
Experience using Building Management Systems (Siemens - Apogee/Desigo) and Environmental Monitoring Systems.
Prior experience using Reliability Centered Maintenance.

cond_0053.responsibilities: Lead the design, installation, start-up, commissioning, qualification, and maintenance of equipment, systems, and utilities associated with cGMP Manufacturing, Laboratories, and Warehouse. Apply a strong understanding of HVAC, controls, mechanical, electrical, and utility systems, and independently troubleshoot as needed. Understanding of thermodynamics, psychrometric properties, and HVAC/mechanical design is highly desirable. Monitor and respond to alarms generated from the BMS/QEMS, including off-hours and weekends. Own the launch and execution of technical investigations, deviations, CAPAs, etc. Related to GMP facilities, utilities, and equipment. Develop and/or enhance departmental standard operating procedures. Ensure through continuous improvement and routine monitoring that equipment performs to design and manufacturer's specifications. Direct the planning, design, budgeting, scheduling, and execution of assigned projects. Establish programs and solutions for increasing uptime and resolving equipment problems that affect the manufacturing process. Independently apply advanced engineering techniques and analysis, and deliver technical guidance to less experienced engineering personnel. Conduct routine inspections of premises and equipment. Oversee work performed by maintenance and/or external contractors to ensure conformance to design and industry standards. Other duties as required.
cond_0053.requirements:
BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering field is required.
5 Years of related BioPharma/Life Sciences experience required.
Prior experience with Facilities operations in a cell therapy manufacturing facility, or experience with cell therapy manufacturing facility MEP design is highly desirable.
Has comprehensive understanding of principles, theories, concepts, and industry practices and standards and their application.
Extensive knowledge and experience designing/operating to ASHRAE, ISO, ISPE, SMACNA, etc. Is highly desirable.
Experience using Computerized Maintenance Management Software (Blue Mountain) is preferred.
Experience using Building Management Systems (Siemens - Apogee/Desigo) and Environmental Monitoring Systems is preferred.
Demonstrable experience with cGMP capital, maintenance, and operating projects.
Prior experience using Reliability Centered Maintenance is highly desirable.
Excellent oral and written communication skills required.

cond_0223.intro: The Senior Plant Engineer is responsible for the operation and optimization of the equipment, systems and utilities of a cGMP Cell Therapy Manufacturing Facility. Coordinate with Maintenance and Metrology groups to develop programs for equipment maintenance and calibrations. Coordinate with the Facilities, Engineering, Operations and Quality teams to ensure maximum uptime and efficiency of all systems and equipment.
cond_0223.responsibilities:
Support the design, installation, start-up, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of equipment, systems and utilities associated with cGMP Manufacturing, Laboratories and Warehouse.
Demonstrate a strong understanding of HVAC, controls, mechanical, electrical and utility systems, and troubleshoot as necessary.
Apply knowledge of thermodynamics, psychrometric properties and HVAC/mechanical design where required.
Monitor and respond to alarms generated from the BMS/QEMS, including off-hours and weekends.
Launch and/or support technical investigations, deviations, CAPAs, etc. Related to GMP facilities, utilities, and equipment.
Develop and/or enhance departmental standard operating procedures.
Ensure through routine monitoring and improvement that equipment works to design and manufacturer's specifications.
Contribute to the planning, design, budgeting, scheduling and execution of assigned projects.
Establish programs and solutions for increasing uptime and resolving equipment problems that affect the manufacturing process.
Apply advanced engineering techniques and analysis independently, and provide technical guidance to less experienced engineering personnel.
Conduct routine inspections of premises and equipment.
Oversee work performed by maintenance and/or external contractors to ensure conformance to design and industry standards.
Other duties as required.
cond_0223.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
5 Years of related BioPharma/Life Sciences experience.
Demonstrable experience with cGMP capital, maintenance, and operating projects.
Comprehensive understanding of principles, theories, concepts, and industry practices and standards and their application.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting skills.
Preferred Requirements
Prior experience with Facilities operations in a cell therapy manufacturing facility, or experience with cell therapy manufacturing facility MEP design.
Extensive knowledge and experience designing/operating to ASHRAE, ISO, ISPE, SMACNA, etc.
Experience using Computerized Maintenance Management Software (Blue Mountain).
Experience using Building Management Systems (Siemens - Apogee/Desigo) and Environmental Monitoring Systems.
Prior experience using Reliability Centered Maintenance.

cond_0255.intro: The Senior Plant Engineer is responsible for the operation and optimization of the equipment, systems and utilities of a cGMP Cell Therapy Manufacturing Facility. Collaborate with Maintenance and Metrology groups to develop programs for equipment maintenance and calibrations. Coordinate with the Facilities, Engineering, Operations and Quality teams to ensure maximum uptime and efficiency of all systems and equipment.
cond_0255.responsibilities: Support the design, installation, start-up, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of equipment, systems and utilities associated with cGMP Manufacturing, Laboratories and Warehouse. Demonstrate a strong understanding of HVAC, controls, mechanical, electrical and utility systems, and be able to troubleshoot as necessary. Understanding of thermodynamics, psychrometric properties and HVAC/mechanical design is highly desirable. Monitor and respond to alarms generated from the BMS/QEMS, including off-hours and weekends. Responsible for launching and/or supporting technical investigations, deviations, CAPAs, etc. Related to GMP facilities, utilities, and equipment. Develop and/or enhance departmental standard operating procedures. Ensure through continuous improvement and routine monitoring that equipment works to design and manufacturer's specifications. Participate in the planning, design, budgeting, scheduling and execution of assigned projects. Establishes programs and solutions for increasing uptime and for equipment problems that affect the manufacturing process. Independently applies advanced engineering techniques and analysis and provide technical guidance to less experienced design and engineering personnel. Conduct routine inspections of premises and equipment. Oversee work performed by maintenance and/or external contractors to ensure conformance to design and industry standards. Other duties as required.
cond_0255.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 5 years of related BioPharma/Life Sciences experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of cGMP capital, maintenance, and operating projects.
Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Facilities operations in a cell therapy manufacturing facility, or familiarity with cell therapy manufacturing facility MEP design.
Background in principles, theories, concepts, and industry practices and standards and their application.
Familiarity with ASHRAE, ISO, ISPE, SMACNA, or similar standards in a design or operations context.
Experience using Computerized Maintenance Management Software (Blue Mountain), or willingness to learn.
Experience using Building Management Systems (Siemens - Apogee/Desigo) and Environmental Monitoring Systems, or willingness to obtain that experience.
Exposure to Reliability Centered Maintenance methodologies.

cond_0319.intro: The Senior Plant Engineer is responsible for the operation and optimization of the equipment, systems and utilities of a cGMP Cell Therapy Manufacturing Facility. Collaborate with Maintenance and Metrology groups to develop programs for equipment maintenance and calibrations. Coordinate with the Facilities, Engineering, Operations and Quality teams to ensure maximum uptime and efficiency of all systems and equipment. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of cGMP facility systems and how they interact.
cond_0319.responsibilities: Support the design, installation, start-up, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of equipment, systems and utilities associated with cGMP Manufacturing, Laboratories and Warehouse. Demonstrate a strong understanding of HVAC, controls, mechanical, electrical and utility systems, and be able to troubleshoot as necessary. Understanding of thermodynamics, psychrometric properties and HVAC/mechanical design is highly desirable. Monitor and respond to alarms generated from the BMS/QEMS, including off-hours and weekends. Responsible for launching and/or supporting technical investigations, deviations, CAPAs, etc. Related to GMP facilities, utilities, and equipment. Develop and/or enhance departmental standard operating procedures. Ensure through continuous improvement and routine monitoring that equipment works to design and manufacturer's specifications. Participate in the planning, design, budgeting, scheduling and execution of assigned projects. Establishes programs and solutions for increasing uptime and for equipment problems that affect the manufacturing process. Independently applies advanced engineering techniques and analysis and provide technical guidance to less experienced design and engineering personnel. Conduct routine inspections of premises and equipment. Oversee work performed by maintenance and/or external contractors to ensure conformance to design and industry standards. Other duties as required.

cond_0330.responsibilities: Support the design, installation, start-up, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of equipment, systems and utilities associated with cGMP Manufacturing, Laboratories and Warehouse. Demonstrate a strong understanding of HVAC, controls, mechanical, electrical and utility systems, and troubleshoot as necessary. Understanding of thermodynamics, psychrometric properties and HVAC/mechanical design is highly desirable. Monitor and respond to alarms generated from the BMS/QEMS, including off-hours and weekends. Actively lead and support technical investigations, deviations, CAPAs, etc. Related to GMP facilities, utilities, and equipment, and communicate findings clearly to relevant teams. Develop and/or enhance departmental standard operating procedures. Ensure through continuous improvement and routine monitoring that equipment works to design and manufacturer's specifications. Participate in the planning, design, budgeting, scheduling and execution of assigned projects, contributing actively in discussions and raising issues early. Establish programs and solutions for increasing uptime and for equipment problems that affect the manufacturing process. Independently apply advanced engineering techniques and analysis, and provide technical guidance to less experienced design and engineering personnel through regular interaction and explanation of trade-offs. Conduct routine inspections of premises and equipment. Oversee work performed by maintenance and/or external contractors, communicating directly with them to ensure conformance to design and industry standards. Other duties as required.
cond_0330.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering field.
5 Years of related BioPharma/Life Sciences experience.
Demonstrable experience with cGMP capital, maintenance, and operating projects.
Comprehensive understanding of principles, theories, concepts, and industry practices and standards and their application.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Preferred Requirements
Prior experience with Facilities operations in a cell therapy manufacturing facility, or experience with cell therapy manufacturing facility MEP design.
Extensive knowledge and experience designing/operating to ASHRAE, ISO, ISPE, SMACNA, etc.
Experience using Computerized Maintenance Management Software (Blue Mountain).
Experience using Building Management Systems (Siemens - Apogee/Desigo) and Environmental Monitoring Systems.
Prior experience using Reliability Centered Maintenance.

BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering field is required.

Extensive knowledge and experience designing/operating to ASHRAE, ISO, ISPE, SMACNA, etc. Is highly desirable.

BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering field is required.
5 Years of related BioPharma/Life Sciences experience required.

Extensive knowledge and experience designing/operating to ASHRAE, ISO, ISPE, SMACNA, etc. Is highly desirable.

Coordinate with the Facilities, Engineering, Operations and Quality teams to ensure maximum uptime and efficiency of all systems and equipment.
cond_0488.responsibilities: Support the design, installation, start-up, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of equipment, systems and utilities associated with cGMP Manufacturing, Laboratories and Warehouse. Demonstrate a strong understanding of HVAC, controls, mechanical, electrical and utility systems, and be able to troubleshoot as necessary. Understanding of thermodynamics, psychrometric properties and HVAC/mechanical design is highly desirable. Monitor and respond to alarms generated from the BMS/QEMS, including off-hours and weekends. Responsible for launching and/or supporting technical investigations, deviations, CAPAs, etc. Related to GMP facilities, utilities, and equipment. Develop and/or enhance departmental standard operating procedures. Ensure through continuous improvement and routine monitoring that equipment works to design and manufacturer's specifications. Participate in the planning, design, budgeting, scheduling and execution of assigned projects. Establishes programs and solutions for increasing uptime and for equipment problems that affect the manufacturing process. Independently applies advanced engineering techniques and analysis and provide technical guidance to less experienced design and engineering personnel. Conduct routine inspections of premises and equipment. Oversee work performed by maintenance and/or external contractors to ensure conformance to design and industry standards. Other duties as required.
cond_0488.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in BioPharma/Life Sciences.
Deep knowledge of principles, theories, concepts, and industry practices and standards and their application.
Proven track record with cGMP capital, maintenance, and operating projects.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills.
Preferred Requirements
Prior expertise in Facilities operations in a cell therapy manufacturing facility, or deep knowledge of cell therapy manufacturing facility MEP design.
Extensive expertise designing/operating to ASHRAE, ISO, ISPE, SMACNA, etc.
Strong command of Computerized Maintenance Management Software (Blue Mountain).
Proficiency in Building Management Systems (Siemens - Apogee/Desigo) and Environmental Monitoring Systems.
Substantial experience using Reliability Centered Maintenance.

cond_0510.intro: The Senior Plant Engineer is responsible for the operation and optimization of the equipment, systems and utilities of a cGMP Cell Therapy Manufacturing Facility. You will regularly collaborate with Maintenance and Metrology groups to develop programs for equipment maintenance and calibrations, and stay in close contact with the Facilities, Engineering, Operations and Quality teams to ensure maximum uptime and efficiency of all systems and equipment.
cond_0510.responsibilities: Support the design, installation, start-up, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of equipment, systems and utilities associated with cGMP Manufacturing, Laboratories and Warehouse. Demonstrate a strong understanding of HVAC, controls, mechanical, electrical and utility systems, and troubleshoot as necessary. Understanding of thermodynamics, psychrometric properties and HVAC/mechanical design is highly desirable. Monitor and respond to alarms generated from the BMS/QEMS, including off-hours and weekends. Actively lead and support technical investigations, deviations, CAPAs, etc. Related to GMP facilities, utilities, and equipment, and communicate findings clearly to relevant teams. Develop and/or enhance departmental standard operating procedures. Ensure through continuous improvement and routine monitoring that equipment works to design and manufacturer's specifications. Participate in the planning, design, budgeting, scheduling and execution of assigned projects, contributing actively in discussions and raising issues early. Establish programs and solutions for increasing uptime and for equipment problems that affect the manufacturing process. Independently apply advanced engineering techniques and analysis, and provide technical guidance to less experienced design and engineering personnel through regular interaction and explanation of trade-offs. Conduct routine inspections of premises and equipment. Oversee work performed by maintenance and/or external contractors, communicating directly with them to ensure conformance to design and industry standards. Other duties as required.
cond_0510.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering field.
5 Years of related BioPharma/Life Sciences experience.
Demonstrable experience with cGMP capital, maintenance, and operating projects.
Comprehensive understanding of principles, theories, concepts, and industry practices and standards and their application.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Preferred Requirements
Prior experience with Facilities operations in a cell therapy manufacturing facility, or experience with cell therapy manufacturing facility MEP design.
Extensive knowledge and experience designing/operating to ASHRAE, ISO, ISPE, SMACNA, etc.
Experience using Computerized Maintenance Management Software (Blue Mountain).
Experience using Building Management Systems (Siemens - Apogee/Desigo) and Environmental Monitoring Systems.
Prior experience using Reliability Centered Maintenance.
